# Security Policy

This is a small, independently maintained Nix packaging and integration
project for PD2 Trader, not the upstream application. Security reports are
handled on a best-effort basis. There is no dedicated security team or
guaranteed response or fix timeline.

## Supported versions

Only the latest published release is supported. Older releases do not
receive security fixes; please update before reporting an issue.

## Reporting a vulnerability

GitHub issues are preferred for ordinary bugs and low-risk security concerns.
Include the affected version, a description of the problem, and reproduction
steps where possible. Never include credentials, tokens, or other private
information.

For a critical vulnerability, such as remote code execution, use this
repository's private vulnerability reporting feature: open the Security tab,
select Advisories, then choose Report a vulnerability. Do not post exploit
details in a public issue. Please allow time for investigation before public
disclosure.

Reports about the upstream application itself should generally go to its
maintainers. If you are unsure whether the problem comes from this
packaging, you can report it here.
